LF_ShopPriceRule.key: The rule's key is a prefab-path substring, or type:<flags>,mode:<mode> to match by arsenal type (mode defaults to 2, any). A key no shipped rule has adds a rule; an existing key changes only the fields given.

LF_VehiclePriceEntry.key: The key is the vehicle's prefab GUID (16 hex digits, the lot's vanilla car or its locked child). A GUID no shipped vehicle has adds one, which must set basePrice. An existing key changes only the fields given; an override of -1 derives the price.

LF_CrimeEntry.key: The key is the crime id, a localization key such as #LF-Offence_Robbery; saved crime records use the same string. An id no shipped entry has adds an offence at the end; an existing id changes only the fields given.

LF_JobTrackDef.key: The key is the job id (CIVILIAN, DELIVERY, FARMER, ...). A job no shipped track has adds one, which must set levelThresholds; an existing key changes only the fields given. The level is 1 plus the thresholds a character's XP has reached, so a changed table reaches existing saves.

LF_JobXpAwardDef.key: The key is the action id the game awards (delivery_run, fruit_pick, gather). An action no shipped award has adds one, which must set job; an existing key changes only the fields given.

LF_JobLicenceGateDef.key: The key is a licence name (LF_ELicenseType, e.g. MINER_GOLD). A licence with no row keeps its shipped gate (its family job, its catalog level); a new row must set job and minLevel.

LF_PoliceRank.key: The key is the rank id (patrol, senior). An id the ladder has changes that rank only in the fields given; an id it lacks appends a rung at the end, because a saved rank is its index and never moves. A remove is refused on a shipped rank and on any rank that is not the last. A rank written in the stream leaves out kit.

LF_ZoneRuleSet.key: The key is the rule name: NORMAL, SAFE or LAWLESS. A rule changes only the fields given. A rule with no shipped entry starts from what the two legacy flags say.

LF_OrgRankDefault.key: The key is a default rank id: founder, officer or member. The entry starts from the shipped rights, so only the permissions written change. It applies to organizations founded afterwards; a saved organization keeps its own ranks.

LF_LicenceRuleDef.key: The key is a licence name as LF_ELicenseType spells it (POLICE_ACCESS, MINER_GOLD, ...). A name that is not a licence is refused. The job level a licence needs is jobs.licenceGates.

LF_AlarmKind.key: The key is the alarm kind id (bank, fuel, store, van), the id a robbed thing's alarm kind names. An id no shipped kind has adds one, which must set prefab; an existing id changes only the fields given. offences replaces the kind's offence list.

LF_SystemSwitch.key: The key is a system id: a Feature/<Area> folder name (Farming) or a named part of one (Robbery, Pager), as Configs/Systems/LF_SystemCatalog.conf lists them. Turning a system off hides its actions, refuses its requests and spawns nothing; its saved data is kept, so turning it on again restores it. A framework system (LOCKED), a system with no switch yet (NOT_YET), and turning off one that an enabled system needs are refused at boot, and the system stays on.

LF_CatalogueItem.key: The key is the item id (pistol_m9, raincoat_green). An id no shipped item has adds one, which must set prefab; an existing id changes only the fields given. removed: true takes the item out of every outlet; a later layer can put it back with removed: false.

LF_OutletOffer.key: The key is outlet/item (gun_counter/pistol_m9): the outlet id a shop counter names, a slash, and the catalogue item id. A new key adds the offer; an existing key changes only the gate fields given. removed: true takes the item off that outlet.
